name: tunnelfm1
author: Fergus
tagline: a hard, hypnotic Detroit techno machine for the FM-1
description: A hard, hypnotic Detroit techno machine: eight synthesized tracks (909-style kick, snare and clap, hats and ride, percussion, a slide bass, chord stabs and bells), each looping at its own length and rate so patterns roll against each other, three decks that cut between presets on the bar, a ping-pong delay, a reverb, a DJ filter and the TUNNEL macro. 128 presets.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Unofficial: not affiliated with M-VAVE.
